This is the second presentation for the course. It will be based on the grant data project you are working on for your final homework. You will present your grant, including aims.  In this presentation please:

+ Limit your presentation to 10 slides.
+ Limit your presentation to 5 minutes + 2 minutes for questions.

Pitch a specific decision: what should be funded, for whom, and why now. Include one slide on evidence/feasibility and one anticipated reviewer concern with your response. AI may help with rehearsal or editing, but you must verify claims and disclose material assistance in speaker notes.
